title: Pradyota (Chanda Pradyota Mahasena)
hook: Pradyota (Chanda Pradyota Mahasena): Avanti ka shaktishali raja
exam_points: Avanti ka sabse prasiddh raja; Bimbisara ka samkalin aur pratidwandwi.
Magadh ke vaidya Jivaka ne Pradyota ka ilaaj kiya (parampara).
Baad mein Shishunaga ne Avanti ki shakti samapt ki.
